evidence_text: Once we verify that all requirements have been met, we will credit the bonus to the account.
claim_statement: The $200 bonus will be credited within 10 business days after the customer meets all requirements.
source_page_text: The $200 opening bonus is available to customers who open an eligible account by November 30 and deposit at least $15,000 in new funds within 14 calendar days. Keep at least $15,000 in the account for 75 consecutive days. Once we verify that all requirements have been met, we will credit the bonus to the account.
judgment_explanation: The text says the bonus is credited after the requirements are verified, but it does not specify that this will happen within 10 business days.
